recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it completes the published issue on an active CodeSystem surface while preserving the already-correct narrative wording.
issue_request: FHIR-24572 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core safety change request asking to change the second 'or' in the clock safety checklist item to 'and' because synchronized server clocks and robustness against clients with wrong clocks are complementary requirements.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in f2b936fb4852f079278d452d0001aa4ee2e54654 and merged by 2abc369c70a7102c2db89737c20ccb1dc576ddab, updating source/safety.html. The safety checklist CodeSystem entry introduced earlier by 76ce9865e683576c6712b6d0c6860272de60ad13 still retained the old 'or' wording.
additional_context: source/safety.html links the checklist to codesystem-safety-entries.html, and source/fhir.ini actively includes codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml under [codesystems]. FHIR Infrastructure minutes confirmed the 7-0-0 persuasive vote. Exact source/Jira/community searches found no later FHIR-core safety reversal or relevant Zulip conflict.
reconciliation: Changed source/codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml so the check-clocks concept definition uses 'and my server is robust...' instead of 'or my server is robust...'.
source_changes: source/codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml: updated check-clocks definition from 'or my server is robust...' to 'and my server is robust...'.
